summary: Short kerb beside a treed lot, houses 12-19 m away, school zone opposite.
reasons: Backs onto a large treed lot

best_section.where: East kerb of Central Avenue beside the treed lot, just south of the school zone marking

drivers.seclusion: East side backs onto a grassy, treed lot; the nearest house is 19 m back at this end, a flat block 16 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street with cars parked at the kerb just south; about one van length of kerb with overhanging trees.
drivers.traffic: Street leading to a junction and a school zone; busy at drop-off times.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, but it is a residential street with no overnight custom.

flags: Short stretch, overhanging trees may limit room
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb from the east gives morning and midday shade.
cannot_judge: Whether tree overhang leaves headroom for the van
